nodes.label: Task J1 Brief — Extract src/core/decodeCore.js (additive, no caller changes)
Window/Policy decode contract (window={arrayBuffer,baseOffset,syntax,littleEndian,implicit,decoder}, policy={forceStoreRaw,noCopy,ignoreErrors})
nodes.rationale: Replaces the lazy core's mutable ctx object with two explicit read-only inputs. There is deliberately no isMeta parameter anywhere in decodeCore: callers construct a meta window (original buffer, explicit-LE, no decoder) or a body window (post-inflate buffer, negotiated syntax/endianness, active decoder), so meta/body resolution happens once at the caller instead of via ternaries scattered through the decode path.

nodes.label: seedReadContext(byteArray, options) — parse + meta/body window construction (deflate-aware via pako inflater)
nodes.rationale: Centralizes parseDicom invocation, syntax normalization, and window construction; for deflated transfer syntax (1.2.840.10008.1.2.1.99) metaWindow indexes the ORIGINAL buffer while bodyWindow indexes the post-inflate buffer, which is what later let fromPart10 handle deflate natively (J4b) and the K3 tail-fallback re-seed a full parse. Meta-group validation and eager-fallback policy deliberately stay in readFileLazy — they are lazy-reader policy, not core.
